examples.text: Den Tisch dort möchten wir kaufen.

glosses: In that place; there (at some distance).

examples.text: You see that house over there? That's where I used to live.

Shepard: I'm looking for an asari.
Dr. Palon: Asari? Well, there's Dr. Iallis over there.
Dr. Palon: There's also our guest, Lady Benezia. Captain Ventralis might know where she is.

glosses: To that place; thither (at some distance).

examples.text: Let's head over there.

glosses: overseas to Europe (for military engagement), especially to the Western Front in France during World War I
At or in a distant but indicated place.

examples.text: See who yonder is.

"A fine man, that Dunwody, yonder," commented the young captain, as they parted, and as he turned to his prisoner. "We'll see him on in Washington some day. He is strengthening his forces now against Mr. Benton out there."
Whose doublewide is that over yonder?

glosses: Synonym of thither: to a distant but indicated place.

examples.text: As for me and the childe, we wyl go yonder.
They headed on over yonder.

glosses: The farther, the more distant of two choices.

examples.text: "You have all necessary proofs in your possession, though you may not be aware of their existence," replied Arden; "will you allow me to open yonder box?"

glosses: Who or which is over yonder, usually distant but within sight.

examples.text: Yonder lass, who be she?

glosses: One who or which is over yonder, usually distant but within sight.

examples.text: The yonder is Queen Niobe.

glosses: The vast distance, particularly the sky or trackless forest.

examples.text:
Off we go in to the wild blue yonder,
Climbing high into the sun...

glosses: Indica un lugar alejado de quienes hablan o se comunican.
Junto con aquí se usa para indicar lugares dispersos e indeterminados.

examples.text: Miramos por aquí y por allí, pero no lo encontramos.

glosses: Indica un aspecto del discurso que es un motivo para lo que sigue.

examples.text: Allí estriba la dificultad.

glosses: Indica un tiempo pasado alejado del presente.

examples.text: Hasta allí todo iba bien.
Desde allí no nos saludamos más.

glosses: Indica un lugar alejado de quienes hablan o se comunican, de forma más imprecisa que allí. Debido a esto, contrariamente a allí, admite grados de comparación.

examples.text: Esperame un poco más allá.

glosses: Indica un lugar fuera del mundo terrenal, en la otra vida.
Se utiliza en frases y fórmulas hechas que indican rechazo y desinterés por lo que pueda ocurrir.

examples.text: Allá él con sus ideas.
Allá se las arregle.

glosses: Indica un tiempo alejado o remoto de forma vaga, por lo común en el pasado.

examples.text: Allá en mi juventud, nosotros no pásabamos el tiempo sentados frente al televisor o el ordenador.
